ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'[CDN].[ECODDataKorygowanego]') and xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF')) drop function [CDN].[ECODDataKorygowanego]

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ECODDataKorygowanego (@gidtyp integer,@gidfirma integer,@gidnumer integer) RETURNS integer AS BEGIN DECLARE @sav_gidtyp integer; DECLARE @sav_gidnumer integer; DECLARE @data integer; SET @sav_gidtyp=0 SET @sav_gidnumer=0 WHILE @gidtyp=2041 AND (@sav_gidtyp<>@gidtyp OR @sav_gidnumer<>@gidnumer) BEGIN SET @sav_gidtyp=@gidtyp SET @sav_gidnumer=@gidnumer SELECT @gidnumer=B.TrN_GIDNumer,@gidtyp=B.TrN_GIDTyp,@data=B.TrN_Data2 FROM CDN.TraNag AS A JOIN CDN.Tranag AS B ON B.TrN_GIDTyp=A.TrN_ZwRTyp AND B.TrN_GIDNumer=A.TrN_ZwRNumer AND A.TrN_GIDTyp=@gidtyp AND A.TrN_GIDnumer=@gidnumer END RETURN @data END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ECODDataKorygowanego TO CDNRaport
if exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'[CDN].[ECODNumerDokumentu]') and xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF')) drop function [CDN].[ECODNumerDokumentu]

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ECODNumerDokumentu (@gidtyp integer,@numer integer,@rok integer,@seria varchar(10)) RETURNS varchar(30) AS BEGIN DECLARE @Ret varchar(30); DECLARE @DocName varchar(30); DECLARE @Format varchar(30); SET @Format=(SELECT Kon_Wartosc FROM CDN.Konfig WHERE Kon_Numer=992); SET @DocName='' SET @DocName=CASE @gidtyp WHEN 2001 THEN 'WZ' WHEN 2033 THEN 'FS' WHEN 2041 THEN 'FK' WHEN 960 THEN 'ZS' WHEN 1152 THEN 'ZZ' WHEN 1489 THEN 'PZ' ELSE CAST(@gidtyp as varchar(10)) END SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'1','@1') SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'2','@2') SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'3','@3') SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'4','@4') SET @Format=REPLACE(@Format,'5','@5') SET @Ret=@DocName+@Format SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@1',CAST(@numer as varchar(6))) SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@2',CAST(@numer as varchar(6))) SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@3',CAST(@rok%100 as char(2))) SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@4',CAST(@rok%100 as char(2))) --by oszczedzic miejsce SET @Ret=REPLACE(@Ret,'@5',CAST(@seria as varchar(6))) RETURN @Ret END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ECODNumerDokumentu TO CDNRaport
if exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'[CDN].[ECODNumerKorygowanego]') and xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF')) drop function [CDN].[ECODNumerKorygowanego]
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ECODNumerKorygowanego TO CDNRaport
if exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'[CDN].[ECODTaxCategoryCode]') and xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF')) drop function [CDN].[ECODTaxCategoryCode]

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ECODTaxCategoryCode (@tax float,@flaga integer,@zlom integer,@grupa varchar(1),@taxKonf varchar(7), @czyPeppol smallint) RETURNS varchar(10) AS BEGIN IF @zlom IN(1,3) AND LTRIM(RTRIM(@grupa)) = substring(@taxKonf,1,1) and @tax = convert(float,substring((@taxKonf),3,len(@taxKonf)-2)) RETURN 'AE' ELSE IF (@tax<>0.0) RETURN 'S' ELSE IF (@flaga=0) RETURN 'E'
IF @czyPeppol=1 RETURN 'Z'
RETURN 'NA' END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ECODTaxCategoryCode TO CDNRaport
if exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'[CDN].[TSToDate]') and xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF')) drop function [CDN].[TSToDate]

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.TSToDate(@ts integer,@ists bit) RETURNS DATETIME as begin IF (@ists=1) RETURN DATEADD( ss, @ts,CONVERT(DATETIME,'19900101',11)) RETURN DATEADD( dd, @ts,CONVERT(DATETIME,'18001228',11)) end
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.TSToDate TO CDNRaport
IF EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'ECODTaxId' AND type = 'FN') DROP FUNCTION CDN.ECODTaxId;

CREATE FUNCTION [CDN].[ECODTaxId] (@NIP varchar(13),@NIPPrefix varchar(2),@GLNOdbiorcy varchar(13)) RETURNS varchar(13) AS BEGIN /* Funkcja do formatowania numeru NIP odbiorcy. W wersji 9.5 NIP zwracany jest bez kresek. */ RETURN replace(@NIP,'-','') END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ECODTaxId TO CDNRaport
IF EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'ECODItemDescription' AND type = 'FN') DROP FUNCTION CDN.ECODItemDescription;

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.ECODItemDescription (@GIDNumer INT, @NazwaOrg Varchar(255), @CzyElektro smallint) RETURNS varchar(255) AS BEGIN /* Funkcja zwraca opis elementu towaru dla ECOD'a */ DECLARE @opis VARCHAR(255) SELECT @opis = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Atr_Wartosc,'')<>'' THEN Atr_Wartosc ELSE @NazwaOrg END FROM CDN.TwrKarty LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.AtrybutyKlasy ON Atk_Nazwa = 'ItemDescription' LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.Atrybuty ON Atr_AtkID = Atk_ID AND Atr_ObiTyp = Twr_GIDTyp AND Atr_ObiNumer = Twr_GIDNumer AND Atr_ObiLp = Twr_GIDLp WHERE Twr_GIDNumer = @GIDNumer
RETURN @opis END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ECODItemDescription TO CDNRaport
